title: Revenue by country
statementMd:
Total revenue per customer country, excluding cancelled orders, rounded to 2 decimals. Highest first.

Expected columns: `country`, `revenue`.

Tables: `customers`, `products`, `orders`, `order_items`.

**Row order matters** for this problem.
hints: Join customers, orders and order items.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT c.country, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price), 2) AS revenue FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' GROUP BY c.country ORDER BY revenue DESC;
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
